v17-33.candidate: Saul said to David, “You certainly cannot go against the foreigner to fight him. For you are a boy, and he has been a warrior from his youth.”

v17-47.candidate: All this assembly will know that the Lord does not save by sword and spear. For the battle belongs to the Lord, and the Lord will hand you all into our hands.”

v18-13.candidate: He removed him from his presence and appointed him a commander of a thousand for himself. David went out and came in before the people.

v18-27.candidate: David rose and went, he and his men, and struck a hundred men among the foreigners. He brought their foreskins to the king and became the king’s son-in-law. Saul gave him Michal, his daughter, as a wife.

v18-7.display:
The women led the song and said,
“Saul has struck his thousands,
and David his tens of thousands.”
